claims.text: Family Oct 20 12:00 UTC: Small Transcribe 3 (flagship batch + diarization), Mini 4B, Realtime, Speech 3 TTS, plus LiveKit voice-agent SDK (listen/reason/speak single pipeline, turn under 1s, barge-in); 50+ transcription langs, 35+ langs and 50+ dialects speech.

Small SOTA transcription/diarization/context-biasing: FLEURS 45 WER Small 4.1/4.0; diarization cpWER 18.4/18.6 vs Pyannote 19.0; keyphrase recall 94.6/81.4; realtime sub-500ms across 40+ langs; TTS internal evals (Voice Code Bench 300 prompts, pronunciation 300 sentences, multilingual 377 prompts, expressive 237; judge gemini-3.8-flash; generated 2026-10-20).
Pricing Mini $0.0035/min, Small $0.004, Realtime $0.008, Speech $13/M chars; agent API $0.04/$0.08; EU/US/global endpoints plus self-deploy (sovereignty); Pro Voice 30min adaptation.
Distinct from W42 INSPECT Le Chonk grounding: Voxtral is speech/TTS/SDK, resolves nothing about grounding weights.
